name: Kaiord
description: Deterministic workout conversion and validation for FIT, TCX, ZWO, Garmin Connect (GCN) and KRD. No AI model runs behind it: name a skill in the first data part of a message, {"skill": "<id>", ...arguments}. A2A 1.0 only: send A2A-Version: 1.0 (0.3 clients get -32009). Tasks finish inside the reply and are not retained.

skills.name: Convert a workout
skills.description: Convert a structured workout between FIT, TCX, ZWO, GCN and KRD. Arguments: input_content (text, or base64 for FIT), input_format, output_format, optional ftp. FIT output is base64 text.

skills.name: Compare two workouts
skills.description: Compare two workout files and list their differences. Arguments: content1, content2, format1, format2.

skills.name: Extract a workout
skills.description: Extract the structured workout from a file as JSON. Arguments: input_content (text, or base64 for FIT), input_format.

skills.name: Get the KRD format spec
skills.description: Return the KRD format specification. Read it before creating or editing KRD documents. No arguments.

skills.name: Inspect a workout
skills.description: Return a human-readable summary of a workout file. Arguments: input_content (text, or base64 for FIT), input_format.

skills.name: List formats
skills.description: List the supported workout formats and their capabilities. No arguments.

skills.name: Round-trip validate FIT
skills.description: Convert a FIT workout to KRD and back, and report tolerance violations. Arguments: input_content (base64 FIT).

skills.name: Validate KRD
skills.description: Validate a KRD JSON document against the schema. Arguments: input_content (KRD JSON).
